title: English Practice Quiz 0742
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'They clean the room.'
options: The room is cleaned by them.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am/is/are + past participle.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: A visitor asks, 'Where is reception?' You say:
options: It is near the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Give a clear location using a complete sentence.

questions.question: Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.
